customManagers.description: compose.yaml's Go, which the shell default hides from the docker-compose manager
GoReleaser in the Packages workflow; keep it equal to the goreleaser image the gate checks the config with
The image buildkit-cache-dance copies the caches with, which is an input of the action
Go tools the Dockerfile and compose.yaml run with go run, by their module path

packageRules.description: An update merges itself once the check gate passes, and CI releases one to Go, a module go.mod requires or GoReleaser as a patch of the last release
An Action no pull request runs, since it publishes, waits for the maintainer, and so does one whose output only such an Action reads

actions/cache, buildkit-cache-dance and the busybox image it copies with wait for the maintainer: only a push to main runs their save step, and a broken one fails the gate that main's releases wait for
A runner update waits for the maintainer, since jobs no pull request runs, such as the release, run on the runner
A GoReleaser major waits for the maintainer: it may rename the release assets, which the gate doesn't check
The Dockerfile's LOWEST_GO_VERSION, the lowest supported Go, which only a major raises; a major that raises it raises this match too
